title: Steps to Apply for Travel Insurance

steps.text:
Navigate to the Insurance Section: 
 - Log in to the mobile application. 
 - From the main dashboard, navigate to the 'Insurance' section and select Travel.

Start a New Application: 
 - Tap on ' Get Travel Insurance Now' .

Fill in Travel and Personal Details: 
 - Choose who the insurance is for (I am buying for myself or I am buying for someone else). 
 Enter the travel details:  ( ▪ Destination: Select the travel location (e.g., Turkey or Egypt) , ▪ Travel Start and End Dates: Specify the duration of the trip ) 
  - Enter personal details (auto-filled for registered users):  (▪ Name on Passport , ▪ Date of Birth , ▪ Passport Number , ▪ Nationality , ▪ Email Address ) 
 - Tap Continue.

Verify Passport Details: 
 - Review and ensure all passport details are accurate. 
 - Tap Ok to confirm or Check Again to modify.

Choose a Plan: 
 - Review the available travel insurance plans (e.g., Sky Plus Travel Insurance). 
 - Check the details of the plan, including: ( ▪ Coverage options (e.g., worldwide coverage, medical emergencies, luggage delays). , ▪ Pricing. ) 
 - Tap Apply Now.

Select Payment Method: 
 - Choose the account to pay from (e.g., Saving Account). 
 - Confirm the payment selection by tapping 'Confirm' .

Review and Agree to Terms: 
 - Verify the payment amount and travel insurance details. 
 - Agree to the terms and conditions by selecting the checkboxes. 
 - Tap ' Pay Insurance ' to complete the payment.

Verify Payment:
 - Enter the 6-digit verification code sent via SMS. 
 - Tap ' Next ' to proceed.

Confirmation: 
 - View the confirmation screen showing: (▪ Reference Number , ▪ Insurance Type ,  ▪ Amount Paid ) 
 - Tap Back to Dashboard to return or ' Download Insurance Policy ' to save a copy.
